verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Honeycomb offers a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of its core product. The only deployment choice documented is picking an EU or North America region for a hosted account. The Kubernetes agent and OpenTelemetry ingestion are data-collection components that send telemetry to Honeycomb, not a way to run Honeycomb itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
